headline: Anthropic files for its IPO, OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra, and Microsoft offers buyouts to a quarter of its staff

stories.title: Anthropic files for its IPO: $16.3 billion in first-half revenue, ticker ANT
facts: Anthropic filed its S-1 with the SEC on Monday and plans to list Class A shares on the Nasdaq Global Select Market as "ANT".
The share count and price range aren't set yet. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are named for the prospectus.
Revenue for the first half of 2026 was $16.3 billion, up from $1.2 billion a year earlier.
The operating loss shrank to $693 million from $2.1 billion. The net loss was $80.7 billion, mostly from non-cash accounting on convertible debt.
Governance stays unusual: the Long-Term Benefit Trust elects a board majority, and a single Class F share held by the co-founders carries 50.1% of the general vote.
The risk factors warn that AI could pose "catastrophic or existential risks", and the BBC says the valuation is expected to top SpaceX's listing.
stories.whyItMatters: It's the first full look at Anthropic's numbers, and the first pure AI lab heading to public markets.

stories.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6.1 Terra, a cheaper, faster model for computer use
facts: It's live today for Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex, and on the API as gpt-6.1-terra.
API prices are $1 per million input tokens ($0.05 cached) and $5 per million output tokens, 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra and GPT-6.1 Sol.
On Agents' Last Exam, OpenAI says it scores 15 points above GPT-5.6 Terra at about a third of the cost, and matches GPT-6 Astra at a tenth of the price per token.
OpenAI says it's about 9× cheaper per task than Claude Opus 5.5 and more than 3× faster.
It has a 1.05M-token context window.
stories.whyItMatters: It puts pressure on the price of agentic computer-use work on the same day Anthropic opened its books.

stories.title: Microsoft offers buyouts to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of staff
facts: Microsoft's new Voluntary Exit Offer covers eligible staff at level 70 and below in the US, Canada, the UK and India.
Only some teams take part. Reports say sales, marketing, security and some engineering and corporate roles are excluded.
Reports put the eligible group at about 60,000 people. Eligible employees get the details by email.
Microsoft says it builds on this year's Voluntary Retirement Program, and calls the offer time-limited, with financial support and career planning.
stories.whyItMatters: It's one of the largest workforce moves in tech this year, and CNBC ties it to an AI-driven efficiency push.

stories.title: Judge rules the DOJ unlawfully fired prosecutor Maurene Comey
facts: Judge Jesse Furman found that her July 2025 firing violated the Civil Service Reform Act and the separation of powers.
He ordered retroactive reinstatement and back pay through 20 December 2025, when she started a new job.
Comey, James Comey's daughter, says she was fired because of her father. The DOJ says it will appeal.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a test case for how far the president's firing power reaches into the civil service.

stories.title: Apple's new iPad mini gets an 8.5-inch OLED screen and the A20 Pro
facts: The 8.5-inch OLED display reaches up to 1,200 nits peak brightness.
Apple claims the A20 Pro brings up to 4.5× the AI performance and 2.7× the graphics performance.
It's 5.4 mm thin and rated IP67.
It starts at $699 (Wi-Fi) and $849 (cellular). Pre-orders open Wednesday, 28 October, and it ships 6 November.
Apple's "Pro and Tell" event follows on Wednesday.
stories.whyItMatters: It's the mini's biggest redesign so far, and it kicks off a busy Apple week.

stories.title: Ex-GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke opens Entire, a Git forge built for agents
facts: Entire's Git-compatible network is now open to everyone, free during the preview.
Instead of pull requests it uses "Trails", summaries that store sessions and prompts next to the code so reviewers can check AI-written changes.
Entire claims pushes are up to 89× faster than on GitHub. It has servers in four locations, including Frankfurt.
Microsoft's M12 fund took part in the $60 million first round, at a $300 million valuation.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a direct bet that agent traffic needs a different kind of forge than GitHub.

facts.text: Walter Koenig, Chekov in Star Trek and Bester in Babylon 5, died Sunday at home in North Hollywood. He was 90.
The Ethiopian Orthodox Church's Holy Synod says more than 60 Orthodox Christians were killed and 20 homes burned in Oromia's Arsi zone.
Audi CEO Döllner defended his Trump rally appearance, and Audi says it wasn't taking a party-political position.
There's backlash after Trump invoked 9/11 to attack Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed.
US Catholic bishops apologised for a Trump meeting they say was "exploited".
